content:
{'text': 'Pebblebee 推出全新「LÔC8」Android Find Hub / Apple Find My 定位器，專為收藏於單車手柄、高爾夫球桿等位置而設計，幫助用戶隨時掌握個人裝備所在。', 'rewritten': 'Pebblebee has launched a new "LÔC8" Android Find Hub / Apple Find My tracker, specifically designed to be concealed inside bicycle handlebars, golf clubs, and similar locations, helping users keep tabs on their personal gear at all times.'}

{'text': 'Pebblebee 「LÔC8」與品牌旗下多款不同造型的定位器同步發售，特別為配合意想不到的位置而度身打造。這款圓柱形定位器主要針對單車及高爾夫球桿，但理論上亦可放入任何「棒狀」物件之中。不過產品定位器顯然屬於嵌入式的設計，而非獨立擺放的款式。', 'rewritten': 'The Pebblebee "LÔC8" is launching alongside several other differently shaped trackers from the brand, each tailored to fit unexpected locations. This cylindrical tracker is primarily aimed at bicycles and golf clubs, but theoretically it could fit inside any "stick-shaped" object. The tracker is clearly meant to be embedded rather than placed standalone.'}

{'text': '「LÔC8」採用透明塑膠外殼，本身並非設計作外露使用。不過技術上，即使直接放入背包或公事包口袋，它仍然可以運作，而且效果應該不俗，因為 Pebblebee 標榜其擁有 3 年電池壽命及「毫不妥協的效能」。只要電池保持原位便沒問題，因為電池是直接外露於管狀結構之中。', 'rewritten': 'The "LÔC8" features a transparent plastic shell and isn\'t really designed to be exposed. Technically, though, it could still work just tossed into a backpack or briefcase pocket, and it should work well, as Pebblebee touts a 3-year battery life and "uncompromised performance." That\'s fine as long as the battery stays in place, because the battery is directly exposed within the tubular structure.'}

{'text': '該電池既非可充電，亦並非可更換設計——至少 Pebblebee 是這樣宣稱的。根據筆者初步搜集資料，內部所採用的 ER10250 電池似乎極難在網上買到，因此更換過程絕非像換鈕型電池般簡單。', 'rewritten': 'The battery is neither rechargeable nor replaceable—at least according to Pebblebee. Based on my initial research, the ER10250 battery used inside appears extremely difficult to find online, so replacing it is far from as simple as swapping out a coin cell.'}

{'text': '不過整體使用過程相當簡便——比起拆走單車手柄膠套輕鬆得多（順帶一提，WD-40 萬試萬靈）。', 'rewritten': "The overall usage process is quite straightforward—much easier than removing your bike's handlebar grips (WD-40 works wonders, by the way)."}

{'text': '定位器頂端設有按鈕，雙按即可啟動配對模式。接著只要用附近的手機透過 Android Find Hub（或 iPhone 的 Find My）進行連接，將定位器放入單車、球桿或任何你打算擺放的位置，便大功告成。盒內附有兩個不同尺寸的襯套，以配合不同大小的單車手柄，目前主要適用於爬山車。用家之後可以套上原有的手柄膠套。電池可使用長達三年；如定位器頂部仍然外露，當你透過 Find Hub 應用程式定位時，更可看到 LED 指示燈亮起。', 'rewritten': "There's a button on top of the tracker—a double press initiates pairing mode. Then simply connect via Android Find Hub (or Find My on iPhone) using a nearby phone, place the tracker in your bike, club, or wherever you intend to position it, and you're all set. Two sleeves of different sizes are included in the box to fit various handlebar diameters, currently primarily suited for mountain bikes. Users can then slide their existing handlebar grips back on. The battery lasts up to three years; if the top of the tracker remains exposed, you'll also see an LED light up when you locate it via the Find Hub app."}

{'text': '這個構思極為簡約，但極具實用潛力。市面上單車失竊的情況極為普遍，雖然加裝 AirTag 類定位器並不困難，但類似今次這類產品幾乎令小偷無從拆除。至於高爾夫球桿，目前更只有這款產品可作選擇。能夠見到如此精緻的方案付諸實現，實在令人欣喜。Pebblebee 早於 2025 年初已率先向本刊透露這項計劃，目前尚有更多構思正在醖釀，包括可嵌入滑雪板等裝置的「板片」式定位器。', 'rewritten': 'The concept is delightfully simple yet brimming with practical potential. Bike theft is rampant out there, and while attaching an AirTag-style tracker isn\'t difficult, a product like this would be virtually impossible for a thief to remove. As for golf clubs, this appears to be the only option currently available. It\'s genuinely exciting to see such an elegant solution come to fruition. Pebblebee first tipped us off about this back in early 2025, and more ideas are in the pipeline, including a "blade-style" tracker designed to be embedded in items like snowboards.'}

{'text': 'Pebblebee 以 1 裝及 4 裝發售「LÔC8」，前者定價 39.99 美元，主要針對個人用家自行安裝於現有裝備；4 裝則特別為整套高爾夫球桿而設，建議交由專業人士安裝。', 'rewritten': 'Pebblebee is selling the "LÔC8" in 1-packs and 4-packs, with the former priced at $39.99 USD aimed at individuals installing it in their existing gear, while the 4-pack is geared toward a full set of golf clubs and is recommended for professional installation.'}
